mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which lowers discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 3.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST > 1050.0) and retail sales (RSAFS > 470000.0) signals robust consumer demand, which drives corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST > 1050.0 and RSAFS > 470000.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 1 month) signals improving labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 1 month and UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO > 104.0) signals expanding manufacturing and services output, which drives corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 104.0.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate below 1000.0 thousand units signals weak residential construction demand, which depresses related sectors and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1000.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 240.0), elevated inflation pressures lead to expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 240.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS rises > 100.0k in 1 month) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE falls > 0.1pp in 1 month) signals a robust labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 100.0k in 1 month AND UNRATE falls > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises > 100.0k in 1 month and UNRATE falls > 0.1pp in 1 month.
